decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials, including the proposed windows,  to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any walsl of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal, because of its position, size, scale and appearance, would be acceptable and would not harm either the appearance of the site itself, the surrounding area or neighbours' living conditions. The proposal therefore meets adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Increased headroom from 1700 to 2250 in basement area to accomodate habitable rooms and new rear door and windows to lower gound level of existing house
